dedupe_keys.name: ns api developer portal dutch railways timetables disruptions and station data

description: The NS API Developer Portal is where Dutch Railways (NS) offers its APIs to developers. The portal says users log in, find suitable (open) APIs, subscribe through the corresponding product and retrieve the data for their app, with interactive testing and a help page; NS holds data such as timetables, engineering works and station information, and with the NS App API any developer can use this open data. Keys are obtained by signing up. Coverage: NS passenger services and stations in the Netherlands. Format and access: REST APIs after registration and subscription. Licence and cost: free to subscribe; terms per product. Caveats: the portal front page is in Dutch and does not list rate limits or licences. It supports network flow and emergency response studies that use timetables and disruption information. It relates to the Dutch NDOV public transport data and the ProRail network dataset in the catalogue.
